prompt1.prompt: Show the top 5 campaigns by ROAS during the last month.
prompt1.db_text:
The top 5 campaigns by Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for July 2025 were:
- CMP_2025_0001 (Dove Nourishing Body Wash Launch): ROAS 6.6
- CMP_2025_0002 (Dove Deodorant Awareness): ROAS 1.2
- CMP_2025_0003 (Dove Hair Therapy): ROAS 4.8
- CMP_2025_0004 (Dove Men+Care Range): ROAS 3.9
- CMP_2025_0005 (Dove Intense Repair Shampoo): ROAS 3.6
These campaigns together contributed approximately 80% of total attributed sales for the brand.

prompt2.prompt: Display the daily ROAS trend for Dove campaigns during July 2025.
prompt2.viz_text: The line chart illustrates the daily ROAS trend for Dove campaigns in July 2025. ROAS remained above 5.5 throughout the month, peaking around July 15 at 7.0, indicating strong mid-month conversion efficiency likely driven by retargeting efforts and promotional offers.

prompt3.prompt: Compare CTR and CVR performance across key media channels (Onsite, Offsite, CTV).

json_data.title: CTR and CVR by Channel – July 2025

prompt3.viz_text: The bar chart compares Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate (CVR) across media channels. Onsite ads achieved the highest engagement and conversion efficiency (CTR 3.0%, CVR 2.8%), while CTV showed minimal direct conversion but contributed to awareness.

prompt4.prompt: Summarize total spend vs. budget utilization by campaign objective.

json_data.title: Planned vs. Actual Spend by Objective – July 2025

prompt4.viz_text: The grouped bar chart displays planned versus actual spend across campaign objectives. Conversion campaigns utilized 90% of budget, indicating efficient pacing. Awareness campaigns slightly underspent (93% utilization), while consideration campaigns were conservative at 88%.

prompt5.prompt: Show the attributed conversions and revenue by week for Dove campaigns.

json_data.title: Weekly Conversions and Revenue – Dove Campaigns (July 2025)

prompt5.viz_text: The dual-axis chart shows weekly conversions and attributed revenue. Conversions peaked in Week 4, with corresponding revenue hitting $17.6K. The consistent week-over-week growth indicates improving campaign efficiency and stronger shopper intent over time.
